basis.ext1_meaning: h_1..h_3 span H^1(O_Gamma_k); n_1..n_3 span H^0(N_Gamma_k/A_0)
basis.ext2_decomposition: Lambda^2 H^1(O) + H^1(O) tensor H^0(N) + Lambda^2 H^0(N)

convention.matrix_orientation: rows are target coordinates; columns are row-major tangent matrix units B_pq
convention.representative: translation-invariant Koszul/Dolbeault minimal representative of the H^1(N) AKS class

scope: These matrices identify the nine geometric AKS cohomology classes at every graph vertex.
They do not provide a dg-resolution representative, an A-infinity module cocycle, higher products, or transferred Atiyah homotopies.
Consequently they are not by themselves sufficient to compute the H268 two-cell transferred obstruction.
